name: Software Engineering
description: Design, build, test and release software systems with code review, testing and dependency controls.

artifact_extensions.purpose: Versioned source under the project's source tree.
Reproducible build output or build configuration.
Automated tests linked to requirements and evidence.
Declared dependencies and their versions/lock state.

gate_additions.condition: Build succeeds from a clean checkout.
Automated tests pass and results are recorded as evidence.
No unresolved critical or high severity security findings in dependencies.
Deployment artifact is reproducible and versioned.

agent_additions.name: code-reviewer
agent_additions.purpose: Specialist review of code quality, readability and maintainability.

checklists: Code review completed by someone other than the author.
Tests cover acceptance criteria for every requirement.
Dependencies reviewed for license and security.
Error handling and input validation present.
No secrets committed to the repository.
